guards.name: HPD: a failed lookup must not render as 'clean'
HPD: an HTTP error must not render as 'clean'
HPD: a thrown network error must not render as 'clean'
guards.find: return { ok: false, failure: { kind: "network_error", detail } };

guards.name: HPD: cure deadline must use the class normalizer
db: a database error must not render SAMPLE demo data
db: the units listing stays bounded
db: the work-orders listing stays bounded
db: the honesty guard is BEHAVIOURAL, not a grep (BUG-224)
guards.expect: rejects on a database error instead of resolving to rows

guards.name: alerts-layer: a failed alerts read must not render as 'no alerts'
guards.replace: if (error) return { ok: true, banner: [], overlay: [] };
guards.expect: returns ok:false when the active-alerts read errors

guards.name: alerts-layer: a failed ack read must not render as '0 of 0 acknowledged'
guards.expect: a failed acknowledgement read reports UNKNOWN counts

guards.name: alerts: a failed STAFF query must not become a send to 0 recipients
guards.expect: rejects when the STAFF query errors

guards.name: alerts: a failed RESIDENT query must not become a send to 0 recipients
guards.expect: rejects when the RESIDENT query errors

guards.name: alerts: an unreadable alert row must not dispatch an empty summary
guards.expect: rejects when the alert row itself cannot be read

guards.name: alerts: a failed super count must not answer 0 ('nobody must ack')
owner-report: a failed violations query must not assert '0 violations'
guards.expect: rejects when the VIOLATIONS query errors
